verdict.rationale: Qodo exposes only a subset of its functionality programmatically: an official MCP server and CLI let agents retrieve and resolve review findings, review changes before a pull request, and fetch applicable rules. Review configuration can also be managed as code via .pr_agent.toml as an alternative to the portal. However, no general-purpose API is documented, and the OpenAPI probe found nothing at any candidate path. Much of what the portal does has no evidenced programmatic equivalent, including governance history, Software Map, Rule Miner, access management, integrations setup and the onboarding wizards. Missing for 10: a documented public REST/GraphQL API, an OpenAPI spec, any explicit statement of API/UI parity, and programmatic coverage of portal-only features (governance dashboards, access control, rule management, integrations setup).
